PS1:disney-s-el-rey-leon-las-aventuras-d.d: Disney's El Rey Leon: Las Aventuras del Poderoso Simba is a platformer game for the PlayStation, published by Activision in 2000.

PS1:doukyuusei-mahjong-best-wing-2800.d: Doukyuusei Mahjong (Best Wing 2800) is a mahjong game for the PlayStation, published by Yumedia (Aroma) in 1997.

PS1:dreams.d: Dreams is an action / platformer game for the PlayStation, published by Cryo Interactive in 1999.

PS1:fox-junction.d: Fox Junction is an action / rpg game for the PlayStation, published by Trips in 1998.

PS1:hi-octane.d: Hi-Octane is a 1995 vehicular combat and racing video game published by Electronic Arts for MS-DOS, PlayStation, and Sega Saturn. It was developed by Bullfrog Productions based upon their earlier Magic Carpet game code. The tracks are wider and more open than most racing games. Hi-Octane was not as well received as the thematically similar Wipeout by Psygnosis and was criticized for the short view distance.

PS1:kids-station-hello-kitty-no-oshaberi.d: Kids Station: Hello Kitty no Oshaberi ABC is a mini games / educational game for the PlayStation, published by Atlus Co in 2001.

PS1:kids-station-kuma-no-pooh-san-mori-n.st: Kuma no Pooh-san - Mori no Nakama to 1, 2, 3 (Controller Set)
PS1:kids-station-kuma-no-pooh-san-mori-n.d: Kids Station: Kuma no Pooh-san - Mori no Nakama to 1, 2, 3 (Controller Set) is a mini games game for the PlayStation, published by Atlus in 2001.

PS1:kiganjou.d: Kiganjou is an action / adventure game for the PlayStation, published by Kodansha in 1999.

PS1:madden-nfl-2005.d: Madden NFL 2005 is an American football simulation video game based on the NFL that was developed by EA Tiburon, along with Exient Entertainment and Budcat Creations, and published by EA Sports. The fifteenth installment of the Madden NFL series, it features former Baltimore Ravens linebacker Ray Lewis on the cover. Al Michaels and John Madden return as game commentators. Released on August 10, 2004, the game is the first Madden game to feature Xbox Live.

PS1:mike-tyson-boxing.d: Mike Tyson Boxing, known in the UK as Prince Naseem Boxing, is a video game developed and published by Codemasters for PlayStation in 2000, and developed by Virtucraft and published by Ubi Soft for Game Boy Advance in 2002.

PS1:nba-basketball-2000.d: NBA Basketball 2000 is a sports video game developed by Radical Entertainment, published by Fox Sports Interactive and distributed by 20th Century Fox Home Entertainment in North America and Activision internationally for Microsoft Windows and PlayStation in 1999.

PS1:nobunaga-no-yabou-bushou-fuuunroku.d: Nobunaga no Yabou: Bushou Fuuunroku is a strategy game for the PlayStation, published by KOEI in 2000.

PS1:retro-force.d: Retro Force is a 1999 shoot 'em up video game developed and published by Psygnosis for the PlayStation. It was only released in Europe.

PS1:sentimental-graffiti-yakusoku.d: Sentimental Graffiti: Yakusoku is a sound novel game for the PlayStation, published by NEC Interchannel in 2001.

PS1:simple-1500-series-vol-78-the-zeroyo.d: Simple 1500 Series Vol. 78: The Zeroyon is a driving / racing game for the PlayStation, published by D3 Publisher in 2001.

PS1:stakes-winner-gi-kanzen-seiha-e-no-m.st: GI Kanzen Seiha e no Michi
PS1:stakes-winner-gi-kanzen-seiha-e-no-m.d: Stakes Winner: GI Kanzen Seiha e no Michi is a horse racing game for the PlayStation, published by Saurus in 1996.

PS1:tokimeki-memorial-taisen-tokkaedama.d: Tokimeki Memorial: Taisen Tokkaedama is a puzzle game for the PlayStation, published by Konami in 1997.

PS1:tomb-raider-v-chronicles-capkore.d: Tomb Raider V: Chronicles (Capkore) is an action / adventure / platformer game for the PlayStation, published by Capcom / Eidos Interactive in 2002.

PS1:walt-disney-le-livre-de-la-jungle-gr.t: Walt Disney Le Livre de la Jungle
PS1:walt-disney-le-livre-de-la-jungle-gr.d: Walt Disney Le Livre de la Jungle: Groove Party is a dancing game for the PlayStation, published by Ubi Soft Entertainment / Disney Interactive in 2000.

PS1:world-stadium-ex.d: World Stadium EX is a baseball / mini games game for the PlayStation, published by Namco in 1996.

PS2:aqua-aqua.d: Aqua Aqua (アクアクア, Akuakua) is a puzzle video game developed by Zed Two, the studio of Ste and John Pickford, for the PlayStation 2. It was published in late 2000 by Imagineer in Japan, and by The 3DO Company in North America and SCi Games in Europe. It is the sequel to Wetrix (1998) and has very similar gameplay; the player, on a landscape, uses Uppers to create walls for enclosures that hold flying water bubbles, contending with hazards like rainstorms, bombs, and ice cubes in the process. Imagineer commissioned a sequel to Wetrix following the predecessor's critical and commercial success.

PS2:chobits-chii-dake-no-hito.d: Chobits: Chii dake no Hito is a visual novel game for the PlayStation 2 in 2003.

PS2:fish-legend-of-seven-waters-and-gods.st: Legend of Seven Waters and Gods

PS2:juiced-2.d: Juiced 2: Hot Import Nights is a 2007 racing video game developed by Juice Games and published by THQ, in collaboration with Hot Import Nights magazine. It is the sequel to the 2005 video game Juiced. The PlayStation 2, Xbox 360 and Nintendo DS versions released in September, the PlayStation Portable and PlayStation 3 versions in October, and the Microsoft Windows version in November. The game is loosely based on the auto show of the same name and utilizes more advanced car modification methods compared to its predecessor.

PS2:mini-desktop-racing.d: Mini Desktop Racing is a racing video game published by Metro 3D and developed by Data Design Interactive. It was released on PC and PlayStation 2 formats in July 2005.

PS2:mtv-music-generator-3.d: MTV Music Generator 3: This Is the Remix, known in Europe as simply MTV Music Generator 3, is a music sequencer program developed by Mixmax and published by Codemasters for PlayStation 2 and Xbox in 2004. It is the sequel of MTV Music Generator 2, published by the same company.

PS2:nhl-2004.d: NHL 2004 is an ice hockey sports video game developed by EA Black Box. It is the successor to NHL 2003. The game adds three European Elite Leagues: Germany's Deutsche Eishockey Liga (DEL), Sweden's Elitserien (SEL), and Finland's SM-liiga. The game was heavily modded during the last 20 years.

PS2:pachitte-chonmage-tatsujin-14-pachin.st: Pachinko Kamen Rider - Shocker Zenmetsu Daisakusen

PS2:portal-runner.d: Portal Runner is a 2001 action-adventure platform game developed by The 3DO Company for PlayStation 2 and Handheld Games for Game Boy Color. The game is a spin-off of the Army Men video game franchise, focusing on a conflict between characters Vikki Grimm and Brigitte Bleu. Both versions were published by The 3DO Company, in the United States it was released in September, and in Europe the following month. It received a mixed reception from critics upon release.

PS2:the-secret-saturdays-beasts-of-the-5.w: The Secret Saturdays: Beasts of the 5th Sun
PS2:the-secret-saturdays-beasts-of-the-5.d: The Secret Saturdays: Beasts of the 5th Sun is an action video game developed by High Voltage Software and 1st Playable Productions and released in 2009 for the Nintendo DS, PlayStation 2, PlayStation Portable, and Wii consoles. The game is based on the Cartoon Network animated television series The Secret Saturdays created by Jay Stephens.

PS3:derrick-the-deathfin.d: Derrick the Deathfin is a game for the PlayStation 3 in 2014.

PS3:godzilla.d: Godzilla (also known as Godzilla: The Game) is a 2014 video game developed by Natsume Atari and published by Bandai Namco Games for the PlayStation 3 and PlayStation 4 based on the Japanese monster Godzilla franchise by Toho. It was first released on December 18, 2014, in Japan only for the PlayStation 3. It was released on July 14, 2015, in North America and on July 17, 2015, in Europe. The Western PlayStation 4 version is based on the upgraded Japanese release called Godzilla VS, released on July 14, 2015, containing more content such as additional monsters.

PS3:harvest-moon-a-wonderful-life-specia.d: Story of Seasons, known in Japan as Bokujō Monogatari and originally known in English as Harvest Moon, is an agricultural farming life simulation video game series created by Japanese video game designer Yasuhiro Wada and developed by Victor Interactive Software (acquired by Marvelous Entertainment in 2003, now Marvelous Inc.). Story of Seasons was the first game to be released under the new international series title of the same name. From 1996 to 2013, Natsume Inc. oversaw the English translation and distribution of the Bokujo Monogatari series in North America, where the games were released under the series title Harvest Moon.

PS3:nba-2k9.d: NBA 2K9 is a 2008 basketball simulation video game developed by Visual Concepts and published by 2K. It is the tenth installment in the NBA 2K franchise and the successor to NBA 2K8. It was released in 2008 for the PlayStation 2, PlayStation 3, Xbox 360, and Microsoft Windows. Kevin Garnett of the Boston Celtics is the cover athlete of the game. NBA 2K9 is the predecessor to NBA 2K10 in the NBA 2K series.

PS3:short-peace-tsukigime-ranko-no-ichib.st: Tsukigime Ranko no Ichiban Nagai Hi

PS3:sniper-ghost-warrior.d: Sniper: Ghost Warrior is a 2010 tactical shooter video game developed and published by City Interactive for Microsoft Windows, Xbox 360 and PlayStation 3. It is the second entry in the Sniper: Ghost Warrior series and is the sequel to Sniper: Art of Victory. The game is based on the role of the military sniper. The player takes on the role of an elite sniper team sent into a hostile area in an attempt to help the rebels of Isla Trueno, a fictitious Latin American country, fight against the force who has toppled their government in a coup d'état.

PSP:capcom-puzzle-world.d: Capcom Puzzle World is a 2007 video game compilation developed by Sensory Sweep Studios and published by Capcom for the PlayStation Portable. It contains five puzzle games: Super Puzzle Fighter II Turbo (1996) Buster Bros. (1989) Super Buster Bros.

PSP:death-jr.d: Death Jr. is a 2005 video game for the PlayStation Portable. The PSP iteration was the first PSP game shown publicly and advertised as a killer-app. It was released to a mixed reception and noted for many problems with the camera, gameplay and uninspiring graphics, but was praised for its Tim Burton themes and quirky characters.

PSP:kingdom-of-paradise.d: Kingdom of Paradise, released as Tenchi no Mon (天地の門) in Japan and Key of Heaven in Europe, is an action role-playing video game developed by Climax Entertainment and published by Sony for the PlayStation Portable in 2005. It was re-released as a PlayStation Network title for PS4 and PS5 in September 20, 2022. A prequel is available in Japan, Korea, and China called Tenchi no Mon 2: Busōden. Heavily influenced by Asian culture in general, and Chinese Wuxia fantasy in particular, the game contains clans named after the Ssu Ling.

PSP:street-fighter-alpha-3-max.d: Street Fighter Alpha 3 Max is a fighting game for the PlayStation Portable, published by Capcom in 2006.

PSP:tenchu-shadow-assassins.d: Tenchu: Shadow Assassins is a stealth game developed by Acquire and published by FromSoftware in Japan and Ubisoft worldwide for the Wii in 2008 and the PlayStation Portable in 2009.
